summary: Ohmyhome Limited filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement covering up to $40,000,000 of Class A ordinary shares issuable to Magnus Capital Ventures under a Standby Equity Purchase Agreement dated October 7, 2026, plus 200,000 commitment fee shares. The company controls timing and amount, selling $200,000-$3,000,000 per advance over 24 months at the lower of $1.26 or 50% of the 180-day lowest closing price, floored at $0.10, capped by a 9.99% beneficial ownership limit. Univest Securities is placement agent at 5% cash fee. This is an ordinary equity line, not a special situation; dilution and below-market pricing are the watch items.
